title: Sources: following Manus probe, Chinese authorities ordered at least one other prominent AI startup, MiroMind, not to send talent and research out of China (Washington Post)
summary: Washington Post: Sources: following Manus probe, Chinese authorities ordered at least one other prominent AI startup, MiroMind, not to send talent and research out of China — A Chinese government probe of a Meta-acquired company, Manus AI, reveals what tech workers see as a new red line. — Summary
